title: Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma Manga Artist Shun Saeki Ends Exclusive Contract With Shueisha
content: Manga artist Shun Saeki announced on Sunday that they have ended their exclusive contract with Shueisha , which they had maintained for many years. Saeki expressed gratitude to all the individuals who have supported them so far.
author: ANN

title: Pikmin Game Gets Short Film Series
content: Nintendo announced on Saturday during a livestream that November 1 is now " Pikmin Day," and announced a new short movie series based on the game titled Hello! Pikmin . The short series' first episode premiered during the stream, and the second episode also debuted on Monday.
author: ANN

title: The Beginning After the End Creator Confirms Hiatus After Major Platform Shutdown
content: The future of The Beginning After the End looks bleak after Tapas announced its shutdown in October, 2026. The web novel has been publishing on the platform in 2017 and only a year later, it received a webtoon adaptation.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Manga That Fans Ranked Higher Than One Piece in 2026
content: One Piece continued its epic narrative in 2026, yet three other series still managed to rank above it according to fans. Eiichiro Oda’s manga has consistently released new chapters for more than a decade, continuing to engage longtime fans and attract new readers every year.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball’s Best Version of Bardock Isn’t the One You Think
content: Bardock, the father of Goku, appeared in numerous Dragon Ball franchise TV anime and movies and had a wide range of personality traits in canon and non-canon outings. It’s time to set the record straight and state that Xenoverse Bardock proved the best blend of all the other characterizations.
author: ComicBook

title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Just Powered Up Super Saiyan God Goku’s Debut – Watch
content: Dragon Ball Super is now working through a new remake of the now classic TV anime series this Fall, and the newest episode just powered up Super Saiyan God Goku’s debut with a new take on the original ritual that brought it to life.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Shonen Jump Creator Returns With New Series After 12 Years & It’s a Perfect Comeback
content: A major creator from Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has returned to Shueisha’s Jump releases with a new manga release after 12 long years, and it’s a perfect comeback for the dark fantasy creator.

title: 27 Years Later, One Piece Has Finally Put the Zoro vs. Sanji Debate to Rest
content: One Piece ‘s latest chapter finally establishes who Zoro and Sanji are as characters and what they represent as Straw Hats. Zoro and Sanji’s positions in the series and their rivalry have been among the most heated debates in the story.
author: ComicBook

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Official Name for New Avatar Form Seen in Finale
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has officially come to an end for its debut season, and the team behind the series have revealed their name for Pavi’s new Avatar State power up seen in the final episodes. Avatar: Seven Havens made its debut this October with Paramount+, and has been a massive hit with Avatar Studios thus far .
